description: Ihor Semko is running for the New York 122nd Assembly District to bring practical, community-focused leadership to Central New York. A father, husband, and HR professional, Ihor knows what working families face: rising costs, property taxes, and limited opportunity. He stepped up because his neighbors deserve a stronger voice in Albany, not more of the same. This campaign is rooted in lived experience, not political ambition.
